name: typed-road
_note_cx: Row CX, September 19 2026. Every other committed script types WELL-FORMED, comma-bearing, question-free orders: measured on commanded_full40, 0 of its 166 strings is question-shaped and 0 omits the addressee comma. So the harness could not see anything row CX changed, and the before/after archives came back byte-identical for a reason that is about the INSTRUMENT and not about the fix. This arm types the way a person does — it asks questions, muses aloud, misspells a name, drops a comma, and names a place the map does not have — and it exists so the typed road has an arm that can regress. Pair with --diplomacy accept. Read the digest for AP: a turn of questions must spend NONE.
